```systemverilog
module counter (
  input  logic       clk,
  input  logic       rst_n,
  output logic [7:0] count
);
  always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) count <= 8'h00;
    else        count <= count + 8'h01;
  end
endmodule

module counter_helper (
  input  logic [7:0] d,
  output logic [7:0] q
);
  assign q = d;
endmodule
```
